title: Industrial machine washing is probably required
text: Industrial machine washing is probably required. One of the tiniest details I missed in the description, was the manufacture says they do not recommend washing this blanket in your washing machine at home. Washing this blanket in an industrial machine is most likely required. And I didn't think to confirmed until after the blanket is here, but our front loading machine has a weight limit of 18lbs. I personally am not interested in wasting my time and money at a laundry mat every time my cat pukes on bed. No matter how comfortable this is, a twenty pound blanket is to work for us.
